what_it_does: SambaNova's SN40L is a specialized AI accelerator chip designed to train and run enormous AI models with a trillion parameters (numbers that define the model's behavior). The fundamental challenge is memory: such massive models require both enormous storage and extreme bandwidth—the speed at which data flows between memory and compute units. Traditional single-memory designs create a bottleneck. This accelerator solves this by stacking two full processor dies (each the size of a small chip) on top of each other using a 2.5D architecture, then equipping them with three layers of memory: ultra-fast but tiny on-chip memory, faster medium-capacity memory built into the package, and slower but enormous off-package memory. The chip coordinates work across both dies to keep the enormous data flow moving.
